changes.before: Would regulate large-scale energy users/data centers through labor and electricity-rate provisions; LA County motion describes a separate energy rate class, clean backup generation, reporting, and local workforce requirements.
changes.after: March 23 amended proposal would establish a special rate structure for data centers taking transmission-level service with estimated peak demand of at least 75 MW, prevent cost shifts, require upfront infrastructure costs, enable prefunding of a 15-year incremental zero-carbon resources contract, and impose prevailing-wage and skilled-and-trained-workforce provisions. The earlier onsite solar/wind/battery-only backup clause is deleted in this version.
